subject.title: Redesign Overview as an operator-first OpenClaw dashboard

question: Should PR #86460 continue as the canonical OpenRouter quota/Overview dashboard path, or should this work fold into the overlapping Overview dashboard direction in PR #77774/current main?
rationale: The patch is stale against current Overview architecture and partially overlaps another open dashboard effort, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product surface or migration path.

options.title: Continue after rebase and repair
options.body: Keep #86460 open, require a current-main rebase, the two provider-usage fixes, and live OpenRouter proof before another merge review.

options.title: Fold into the dashboard effort
options.body: Move the useful OpenRouter usage pieces into the canonical Overview/dashboard PR or a new maintainer-owned branch, then close this stale branch once the replacement has proof.

options.title: Pause until dashboard direction settles
options.body: Leave the PR open but blocked until maintainers choose the Overview quota design shared with #77774.

recommendation.title: Continue after rebase and repair
recommendation.body: Keep #86460 open, require a current-main rebase, the two provider-usage fixes, and live OpenRouter proof before another merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest recent history across provider quota routing, Overview quota display, and OpenRouter-adjacent work.
